correctness.rationale: The F2 linear-chain system admits an exact first integral on each side of v=1. Its sign structure proves finite-time positive blow-up for v(0)<1, finite-time negative blow-down for v(0)>1, and immediate singularity for v(0)=1; Gaussian-tail inversion yields the stated universal leading constants and subleading terms.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Standard linear-chain, integrating-factor, and Gaussian-tail methods are excluded from novelty. No located correction or source-specific follow-up to arXiv:2609.15470v1 gives the displayed initial-memory trichotomy, exact first integral, or sharpened F2 asymptotics.

value.rationale: The source theorem is stated for every positive bounded history but its proof restricts to v<1. The result identifies the missing hypothesis, classifies the omitted half-plane exactly, supplies elementary counterexamples to the unrestricted statement, and determines the previously unspecified leading amplitudes.
